notes: All numbers were read from the PDF page images (D01 PDF pages 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 16) because the pdftotext extraction drops decimal points and renders parentheses as digits in Tables 1-6 (e.g. '00941' for 0.941 and '4000035' for (0.003)). Table 5 prints odds ratios with standard errors in parentheses; the paper does not say whether the parenthesised values are standard errors of the odds ratio or of the underlying coefficient, but the magnitudes (e.g. 0.000 for odds ratios near 1) are consistent with Stata's delta-method standard errors of odds ratios. Several standard errors are printed as 0.000 or 0.0000, which limits forensic z-checks. The significance key is identical under Tables 1, 5 and 6: '+p < 0.1; *p < 0.05; **p < 0.01.' No exact p-values are printed anywhere; text statements of the form 'p < 0.01' are inequalities and are recorded in stars_or_inequality. The paper does not state whether tests are one- or two-tailed. Per-quarter Min and Max of Table 4 are recorded in the row labels of T161 and T162 rather than as separate rows. Table 2 percentages and cumulative percentages are recorded in the row-label text of T163-T171.
